graph_comparison.original_limits: Eighteen strict allocation sweeps and sixty controlled aborts stop at partial graph restoration assertions; later ordinals and CRT retention in aborted cases remain unmeasured. Eighteen separate retention-only experiments reclaim current reachable graph samples only, leaving 1-6 orphaned entry samples and 3-12 retained blocks each; no restoration/retry claim for those original experiments.
graph_comparison.ownership: Prepare all equivalent working lists and initial deduplicated sample inventory before parking original nodes. Initial samples remain alive until complete-loop commit. Inner per-curve guards unwind before allocation-free graph cleanup; clear cache and all pending shared aliases before deleting new graph samples, then restore original nodes/sharing. Success retires initial objects once and leaves final caller-owned graph. IDs stay consumed; evaluator scratch and metadata are not restored.
graph_comparison.controls: Four curves, three actual initialized types plus mixed graphs; non-manifold/shared/closed/reversed/distinct/two-endpoint layouts; independently checked analytic interiors, physical mesh copies and adjacency observers. Successful repeat and a later operation built from actual samples. All measured ordinals denied once, no rollback allocation, exact restoration/retry and final denial after all requests/three committed curves. Empty graph is guard-only, not positive graph coverage. Deliberate list-move/UAF/leak/hook controls remain.
graph_comparison.allocation_behavior: Prepared working lists and inventory intentionally change allocation timing/counts/bytes/peak storage. Original capture/retirement blocks are wrapped verbatim with existing map/set storage; no unchanged-allocation or performance claim.
graph_comparison.original_provenance: Nineteen Git-pinned production units plus probe and verified verbatim capture/retirement interface adapter; candidate twenty actual production units plus probe. Controlled driver uses actual per-curve publication/sample/rebuild operations, not full historical Generator/Adapter TUs or upstream numerical selection.
graph_comparison.remaining_scope: Fixed topology, initialized parametric curves, exclusively deletable collectively owned samples/no competing geometry-control or physical mesh owner, nonthrowing destructors and qualified inner operations. Evaluator scratch, whole AdaptCurve metadata/error/history/budget, patch/mesh/acceptance rollback and full-process/parallel/LSan/UBSan remain unqualified.

retention_policy: Compact command/case inventory, outcomes, calibration/graph observations and raw-log hashes. Complete fresh raw reports and all per-ordinal observations remain local with the recorded report SHA256; prior boundaries also retain their original evidence. No raw log normalization or failure suppression.
